notes: VAT 24% (VAT Act No. 50/1988 art. 14(1); Skatturinn key rates). Bullion NOT exempt: the complete art. 2(3) exemption list was read (services only) - gold appears nowhere, and Iceland (EEA, not EU) has no investment-gold scheme; a Skatturinn ruling confirms gold/silver coins bear 24%. Duty null: Iceland has its own customs tariff (not the EU CN); no official 7108 line openable.

sources.name: VAT Act No. 50/1988 (Althingi official law collection), art. 14(1)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: VAT shall be 24%; the art. 2(3) exemption list read in full contains no gold item
sources.quote: Virðisaukaskattur skal vera 24% og rennur hann í ríkissjóð.

sources.name: Skatturinn (skatturinn.is) - Customs Ruling No. 23/2017
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: gold and silver coins under tariff headings 7118/9705 bear 24% VAT; art. 36 import-exemption list has no bullion item
sources.quote: Vörur sem falla undir tollskrárnúmer 7118.9000 bera 24% virðisaukaskatt samkvæmt tollskrá.
